about: Words for the confidence check (R-30). The server sends codes only; each code's text lives here, so nothing the student typed is ever in a confidence event. The calibration lines are for Your map, from one beat's level and the verdict that followed.

reasons.checked_back: I put it back in to check
reasons.each_step: Every line followed from the one before
reasons.like_last_one: It looked like the last one

key_step.ask: Which step was the key one?

steps.undo_first: Undoing the added or taken-away number first, on both sides
steps.undo_times: Dividing both sides by the number in front of x
steps.check_back: Putting the answer back in to check it
steps.read_problem: Reading what was done to x, in order

right.1: You said guessing, and it was right. Next time, check it so you know.
right.2: You said fairly sure, and you were right. You know this better than you feel.
right.3: You said certain, and you were right. Trust that feeling.

wrong.1: You said guessing, and it wasn't right. That's where learning starts.
wrong.2: You said fairly sure, but it wasn't right. Checking it first catches that.
wrong.3: You said certain, but it wasn't right. Checking it first catches that.
